name: Therapy Bar & Grill
description: Therapy Bar and Grill is a lively venue that offers a vibrant karaoke experience with a welcoming atmosphere. Known for its friendly staff and regular live music events, it features a good sound system and a decent song selection. The venue is clean, well-maintained, and provides food and drinks, making it a great spot for casual nights out, celebrations, or just unwinding with friends. It hosts themed nights like karaoke and open mic, creating a fun environment for all ages until 9 pm, when it becomes more adult-oriented.
